Supplier A offers a unit cost of $50 with a delivery time of 3 days, Supplier B offers a unit cost of $45 with a delivery time of 5 days, and Supplier C offers a unit cost of $60 with a delivery time of 2 days. The company needs to minimize total cost while meeting demand.

The company needs 1000 units per month.

Delivery time must not exceed 4 days on average.

The company must select at least 2 suppliers to ensure supply chain resilience.

Supplier A can supply up to 600 units, Supplier B can supply up to 500 units, and Supplier C can supply up to 400 units.
